test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Place where objects of importance are exhibited
solution: The correct answer is '**Museum**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Museum**'. • It means 'a building where collections of valuable and interesting objects are kept and shown to the public'. (बहुमूल्‍य और रोचक वस्‍तुओं का संग्रहालय और प्रदर्शन-स्‍थल; संग्रहालय, म्‍यूजि़यम) • *Example: Have you been to the National **Museum** in Delhi?* **Correct Answer:__** *Museum.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Treasury**: the funds or revenue of a state, institution, or society. (किसी राज्य, संस्था या समाज का धन या राजस्व) • **Fair**: appropriate and acceptable in a particular situation. (उचित, सही) • **Exhibition**: a collection of objects, for example works of art, that are shown to the public. (प्रदर्शनी, नुमाइश) • **Tomb**: an excavation in which a corpse is buried 14c:Tb1f, The erroneously spelt word is '**Temprate**'.
